parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

1️⃣
although[ɔːlðou]conj.
You use although to say that one thing is contrasted by another. (mặc dù)
→ Although she was late, her friends gave her a warm welcome.
2️⃣
apply[əplai]v.
To apply something means to put it on. (bôi, thoa, áp dụng)
→ She always applies makeup to her face before going outside.
3️⃣
await[əweit]v.
To await something means to wait for it. (chờ đợi)
→ The players awaited the judge's decision.
4️⃣
beloved[bilʌvid]adj.
When something is beloved, it is very special and you like it very much. (yêu dấu)
→ The boy took a nap next to his beloved cat.
5️⃣
bury[beri]v.
To bury someone or something means to put them in the ground. (chôn cất)
→ They buried their grandfather under his favorite tree after he died.
6️⃣
climate[klaimit]n.
A climate is the usual weather in a place. (khí hậu)
→ The climate in the desert is very hot.
7️⃣
complain[kəmplein]v.
When you complain, you say that you are unhappy about something. (phàn nàn)
→ The workers complained that they were being treated unfairly.
8️⃣
confuse[kənfju:z]v.
To confuse someone means to make them feel like they are unsure. (làm bối rối, làm lúng túng)
→ The sign confused the traveler because it pointed in two directions.
9️⃣
due[dju:]adj.
When something is due, it is expected to happen or be done at that time. (đến hạn)
→ The papers were due on the 19th.
🔟
entire[intaiər]adj.
When you talk about an entire thing, you are talking about the whole thing. (toàn bộ)
→ He was so hungry that he ate the entire pizza by himself.
1️⃣1️⃣
establish[istæbliʃ]v.
To establish something means to create it. (thành lập)
→ He wanted to establish a club for people to help the Earth.
1️⃣2️⃣
furnace[fə:rnis]n.
A furnace is a place where heat is made. (lò sưởi, lò luyện)
→ Mr. Jones came to fix the furnace.
1️⃣3️⃣
leash[li:ʃ]n.
A leash is a rope or chain that is used to lead an animal. (dây xích, dây dắt chó)
→ A lot of dogs must wear a leash to keep them from running away.
1️⃣4️⃣
mature[mətʃuə:r]v.
To mature means to grow up to become an adult. (trưởng thành)
→ When they matured, they became as tall as their parents.
1️⃣5️⃣
measure[meʒər]v.
To measure something means to find out the quality, value, or effect of it. (đo lường)
→ The scientists carefully measured the amount of chemicals in the tubes.
1️⃣6️⃣
midst[midst]n.
The midst of something is the middle of it. (ở giữa)
→ She was in the midst of cleaning when the telephone rang.
1️⃣7️⃣
misery[mizəri]n.
Misery is extreme suffering. (sự khốn khổ)
→ There was a lot of misery after Sam lost his dog.
1️⃣8️⃣
prior[praiər]adj.
When something happened prior to something else, it happened earlier. (trước, ưu tiên)
→ Ron had to wait since he arrived prior to the scheduled meeting time.
1️⃣9️⃣
research[risə:rtʃ]n.
Research is close and careful study to discover new things. (nghiên cứu)
→ Scientists did a lot of research on the subject of blood type.
2️⃣0️⃣
variety[vəraiəti]n.
A variety of something is a group of many different kinds of it. (sự đa dạng)
→ There are a variety of flowers at the shop.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the word that is a better fit for each blank.

questions.content: 1. After weeks of hard work, the scientists must ________ the results of their ________.
questions.explanation: await là chờ đợi, research là nghiên cứu. 'await the results of their research' (chờ đợi kết quả nghiên cứu của họ).

questions.content: 2. After the death of her ________ pet, the woman felt nothing but ________ for many weeks.
questions.explanation: beloved là yêu dấu, misery là sự khốn khổ.

questions.content: 3. The store had a ________ of canned vegetables, but the man ________ that they didn’t have his favorite brand.
questions.explanation: variety là sự đa dạng, complained là đã phàn nàn. 'a variety of' là nhiều loại.

questions.content: 4. The new schedule ________ passengers who thought the train was ________ at 8 a.m.
questions.explanation: confused là làm bối rối, due là đến hạn (có mặt).

questions.content: 5. The island was a great place to ________ a hotel since the ________ was warm throughout the year.
questions.explanation: establish là thành lập/xây dựng, climate là khí hậu.

questions.content: 6. ________ he had a lot of bad luck in the past, he refused to let ________ events stop him from moving forward.
questions.explanation: Although là mặc dù, prior là trước đó.

questions.content: 7. The ________ was turned up to the highest temperature, but it couldn’t heat the ________ room.
questions.explanation: furnace là lò sưởi, entire là toàn bộ.

questions.content: 8. In the ________ of a terrible war, the young boys had to ________ quickly.
questions.explanation: midst là ở giữa, mature là trưởng thành. 'In the midst of' là ở giữa bối cảnh nào đó.

questions.content: 9. To make sure the dog’s ________ was long enough, Bob took out a ruler and ________ it.
questions.explanation: leash là dây xích chó, measured là đã đo đạc.

questions.content: 10. She insisted that they ________ her mother’s favorite perfume before they ________ her.
questions.explanation: apply là bôi/thoa, buried là đã chôn cất.

sections.title: Exercise 2 Part A: Match the phrases to make complete sentences.

questions.content: 1. Although he didn’t know how to dance, _____
options: he went to the party anyway
before new medicines can be created
food to choose from at the store
questions.explanation: Mặc dù anh ấy không biết khiêu vũ, anh ấy vẫn đi dự tiệc.

questions.content: 2. A furnace keeps _____
options: a room warm during the winter
the team’s best player had to be replaced
many travelers want to vacation there
questions.explanation: Lò sưởi giữ cho căn phòng ấm áp trong mùa đông.

questions.content: 3. Florida’s warm climate makes _____
options: many travelers want to vacation there
questions.explanation: Khí hậu ấm áp của Florida khiến nhiều du khách muốn đi nghỉ tại đó.

questions.content: 4. He wanted to establish _____
options: food to choose from at the store
the team’s best player had to be replaced
questions.explanation: Anh ấy muốn thành lập một trường học cho trẻ em khiếm thị.

questions.content: 5. The train was due to arrive at _____
options: before new medicines can be created
a room warm during the winter
questions.explanation: Đoàn tàu dự kiến đến vào khoảng 7 giờ sáng.

questions.content: 6. A lot of research is needed _____
options: food to choose from at the store
before new medicines can be created
questions.explanation: Cần rất nhiều nghiên cứu trước khi có thể tạo ra các loại thuốc mới.

questions.content: 7. Shoppers have a variety of _____
options: food to choose from at the store
the team’s best player had to be replaced
a room warm during the winter
questions.explanation: Người mua sắm có nhiều loại thức ăn để lựa chọn tại cửa hàng.

questions.content: 8. In the midst of the game _____
options: the team’s best player had to be replaced
before new medicines can be created
many travelers want to vacation there
questions.explanation: Giữa trận đấu, cầu thủ giỏi nhất của đội phải được thay ra.

questions.content: 9. A leash keeps _____
options: food to choose from at the store
questions.explanation: Dây xích giữ cho chó không chạy đi mất.

questions.content: 10. Her beloved sister _____
options: before new medicines can be created
the team’s best player had to be replaced
questions.explanation: Người em gái yêu dấu của cô ấy luôn khiến cô bình tĩnh lại.

sections.title: Exercise 2 Part B: Match the clauses to make complete sentences.

questions.content: 1. To determine if the new drug was safe, _____
options: but his prior works were very successful
because the pirate had buried it
so she applied makeup to her face
questions.explanation: Để xác định xem thuốc mới có an toàn không, các nhà khoa học đã đo lường mọi hiệu ứng.

questions.content: 2. His newest book did not sell well, _____
options: but his prior works were very successful
so the diners complained to the waiter
but she became more serious as she matured
questions.explanation: Cuốn sách mới nhất của ông bán không chạy, nhưng các tác phẩm trước đó thì rất thành công.

questions.content: 3. He wanted to finish the race, _____
options: so they drank the entire bowl of punch
but the pain in his ankle gave him too much misery
so she patiently awaited his letters
so she applied makeup to her face
questions.explanation: Anh muốn hoàn thành cuộc đua, nhưng cơn đau mắt cá chân mang lại quá nhiều đau khổ.

questions.content: 4. He lost his map, _____
options: because the pirate had buried it
but his prior works were very successful
so the diners complained to the waiter
questions.explanation: Anh ấy mất bản đồ nên đã bị bối rối mất phương hướng.

questions.content: 5. The soup was cold, _____
options: so she patiently awaited his letters
but the pain in his ankle gave him too much misery
so the diners complained to the waiter
so they drank the entire bowl of punch
questions.explanation: Súp bị nguội, vì thế các thực khách phàn nàn với người phục vụ.

questions.content: 6. Sue was very silly as a child, _____
options: but she became more serious as she matured
because the pirate had buried it
questions.explanation: Sue hồi nhỏ rất ngốc nghếch, nhưng cô trở nên nghiêm túc hơn khi trưởng thành.

questions.content: 7. No one could find the treasure _____
options: but his prior works were very successful
because the pirate had buried it
so the diners complained to the waiter
so she applied makeup to her face
questions.explanation: Không ai có thể tìm thấy kho báu vì tên cướp biển đã chôn nó.

questions.content: 8. He said he would write to her, _____
options: but the pain in his ankle gave him too much misery
so she patiently awaited his letters
so they drank the entire bowl of punch
questions.explanation: Anh nói sẽ viết thư cho cô, vì thế cô kiên nhẫn chờ đợi thư của anh.

questions.content: 9. She wanted to look older, _____
options: so she applied makeup to her face
but she became more serious as she matured
because the pirate had buried it
questions.explanation: Cô ấy muốn trông lớn tuổi hơn, nên đã trang điểm lên mặt.

questions.content: 10. They were thirsty, _____
options: so they drank the entire bowl of punch
but his prior works were very successful
so the diners complained to the waiter
questions.explanation: Họ đang khát nên đã uống toàn bộ bát nước uống (punch).

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
Laika, the Space Dog

One of the world's most beloved space travelers was also the furriest. Laika was a little dog living on the streets of Moscow, Russia. She matured on the streets because no one would give her a home. She had to learn how to live without eating much. She found ways to keep warm in a very cold climate. Scientists thought a tough dog like Laika would do well in a project they were putting together.

In a prior launch, Russia had put the first man-made object into space. Now, scientists wanted to see if a living thing could go to space. Although many facts about space had been learned, they weren't enough to help send humans to space safely.

Laika and two other dogs were chosen to help scientists with their research. The animals were used in a variety of tests. In the end, though, only Laika would go to space. On November 3, 1957 the Sputnik 2 spaceship was due to leave Earth.

Scientists carefully applied wires to Laika's skin to measure her body's reactions once she got into space. Laika also wore a special leash. Without it, she would float around in the spaceship. Soon after, Laika left the planet. Scientists on Earth awaited information from the ship.

But in the midst of so much excitement, something very sad happened. Scientists were able to tell that Laika was under a lot of stress. The trip confused and scared her. Laika's entire ship had become as hot as a furnace. Scientists were powerless to help the dog in her misery. After about five hours, Laika died.

Some have complained that the little dog should never have been used in the mission. Scientists knew that she would not survive the trip. Laika was never buried, but a memorial has been established in Moscow. There are many songs and books about her, too. It seems that Laika became a hero to many people.

sections.title: Reading Comprehension: Part A
sections.content: Mark each statement T for true or F for false. Rewrite the false statements to make them true.

questions.content: 1. Scientists did a variety of tests for research before the Sputnik 2 was due to leave.
questions.explanation: Đúng (True). Câu chuyện nói: 'The animals were used in a variety of tests... Sputnik 2 spaceship was due to leave Earth.'

questions.content: 2. Wires were applied to Laika’s leash so that scientists could find the ship.
questions.explanation: Sai (False). Dây (wires) được gắn vào da của Laika (Laika's skin) để đo lường phản ứng của cơ thể cô ấy.

questions.content: 3. Although Laika could not be buried, a spaceship was established in her honor.
questions.explanation: Sai (False). Một đài tưởng niệm (a memorial) được thành lập để vinh danh Laika, không phải một con tàu vũ trụ.

questions.content: 4. In the midst of the scientists’ excitement, Laika’s ship became too hot.
questions.explanation: Đúng (True). Câu chuyện viết: 'In the midst of so much excitement... Laika's entire ship had become as hot as a furnace.'

questions.content: 5. In a prior launch, scientists sent two other dogs into space.
questions.explanation: Sai (False). Trong lần phóng trước, Nga đã đưa vật thể nhân tạo (man-made object) đầu tiên vào không gian.

questions.content: 6. Many people complained that Laika should not have gone to space.
questions.explanation: Đúng (True). Một số người đã phàn nàn (complained) rằng không bao giờ nên dùng chú chó nhỏ cho sứ mệnh này.

questions.content: 1. Why did scientists choose Laika for the mission?
options: She was a beloved space traveler.
The trip to space confused her.
She needed to wear a special leash.
questions.explanation: Các nhà khoa học nghĩ rằng một chú chó kiên cường (tough) như Laika sẽ làm tốt trong dự án.

questions.content: 2. Why did Laika die during the trip?
options: The ship became as hot as a furnace.
The scientists were under a lot of stress.
Living things cannot survive in space.
The scientists didn’t get information from her.
questions.explanation: Cô ấy chết vì con tàu trở nên nóng như lò sưởi (as hot as a furnace).

questions.content: 3. Scientists made Laika wear a special leash because they ________.
options: were awaiting information from the ship
were not able to bury her
didn’t want her to float around the ship
questions.explanation: Không có dây xích, cô ấy sẽ trôi nổi khắp con tàu (float around in the spaceship).

questions.content: 4. Why did scientists apply wires to Laika’s skin?
options: To take her for the entire trip
questions.explanation: Các nhà khoa học gắn dây điện vào da Laika để đo lường các phản ứng của cơ thể cô ấy (measure her body's reactions).
